headline: Northwestern (Minn.) runs away with UMAC scoring
dek: Northwestern (Minn.) has scored 70 goals and conceded twelve across all matches, compiling thirteen wins, two draws, and three losses while outscoring Martin Luther and Crown combined. UW-Superior still leads the conference table without a league defeat after winning their November meeting.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring in the conference splits sharply between the top tier and the rest: UW-Superior's 47 goals alone exceed the combined output of Bethany Lutheran, North Central (Minn.), and Minnesota Morris.

wire.line: UW-Superior finished conference play unbeaten, with fifteen different players scoring across all matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Crown goalkeeper Rachel Fuller has recorded 157 saves against 40 goals conceded, posting a 0.797 save percentage with five shutouts.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: North Central (Minn.) has conceded 65 goals while scoring fourteen across three wins, one draw, and thirteen losses, allowing more goals than Bethany Lutheran and UW-Superior combined.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Crown freshman Eva Starkey, listed as a goalkeeper, has scored ten goals and added two assists on 43 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four August matches remain past their scheduled dates with no published result: Minnesota Morris at Dakota County Technical, Northwestern (Minn.) against Hamline, Bethany Lutheran against Gustavus Adolphus, and Crown against Wisconsin-Stout.

last_match.line: Crown closed its schedule with consecutive scoreless defeats away from home.

next_match.line: Northwestern (Minn.) is the only UMAC program still playing, returning from its November defeat at UW-Superior.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
